description: Use this to list the blockchain transactions belonging to an XDaLa session. This returns the timeline of transaction hashes, blocks, fees and iteration steps. It does not return full engine payloads, API saves or contract read results.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

owner.description: EVM address of the XDaLa session owner or relevant account.

page.description: One-based page number for paginated explorer/API results.

sessionId.description: XDaLa session identifier used to query runtime or explorer data.

name: get_session_transactions

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.

title: Get XDaLa session transactions
